# Configuration reference

Widgets live in `config/widgets.ini`. Each `[section]` is one widget; the
section name is a label you choose, and it is what the settings editor
shows in its list.

```ini
[clock]
type=clock
preset=midnight
anchor=top_right
x=-60
y=64
width=360
height=156
font_size=66
```

Only `type` is required. Every other key falls back to its default, and a
`preset` supplies a themed set of defaults that individual keys override.

Colours are hex `AARRGGBB`. `RRGGBB`, `#RGB` and `#ARGB` are also accepted
and are expanded to full opacity where no alpha is given. An alpha of `00`
means "off" for effects such as shadow, glow and outline.

## General

| Key | Applies to | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | all | `clock`, `notes`, `image` | `clock` | Which widget to render |
| `enabled` | all | true / false | `true` | Set to false to keep the config but hide the widget |
| `preset` | all | `midnight`, `glass`, `minimal`, `neon`, `sunset`, `aurora`, `terminal`, `blueprint`, `carbon`, `paper`, `nord`, `mocha`, `dracula`, `gruvbox`, `solarized` | (none) | Applies a themed set of colours; individual keys still win |

## Layout

| Key | Applies to | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchor` | all | `top_left`, `top_center`, `top_right`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `bottom_left`, `bottom_center`, `bottom_right` | `top_left` | Corner or edge that X/Y are measured from |
| `monitor` | all | integer | `-1` | Monitor index, or -1 for the primary display |
| `x` | all | integer | `0` | Horizontal offset from the anchor, in pixels |
| `y` | all | integer | `0` | Vertical offset from the anchor, in pixels |
| `width` | all | integer | `320` | Widget width in pixels |
| `height` | all | integer | `140` | Widget height in pixels |
| `opacity` | all | number | `1.0` | Master transparency, 0.0 to 1.0 |
| `click_through` | all | true / false | `true` | Let clicks pass to the desktop underneath |

## Clock

| Key | Applies to | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | clock | `digital`, `analog` | `digital` | Digital readout or an analog dial |
| `format` | clock | `12h`, `24h` | `12h` | Shorthand used when no explicit pattern is set |
| `show_seconds` | clock | true / false | `false` | Include seconds and tick once a second |
| `time_format` | clock | text | (none) | Custom pattern, e.g. h:mm tt - overrides Hour format |
| `blink_separator` | clock | true / false | `false` | Fade the separator on odd seconds |
| `show_date` | clock | true / false | `true` | Draw a second line below the time |
| `date_format` | clock | text | `dddd, MMMM d` | Date pattern, e.g. ddd d MMM yyyy |
| `date_font_family` | clock | font name | (none) | Blank inherits the main font |
| `date_font_size` | clock | number | `0` | 0 means 40% of the time size |
| `date_font_style` | clock | `regular`, `bold`, `italic`, `bold_italic` | `regular` | Weight and slant of the date line |
| `date_color` | clock | colour | `00000000` | Alpha 0 derives 60% of the text colour |
| `date_letter_spacing` | clock | number | `0` | Extra pixels between date glyphs |
| `date_transform` | clock | `none`, `upper`, `lower` | `none` | Force upper or lower case on the date |
| `date_gap` | clock | number | `2` | Vertical gap between the time and date rows |
| `time_ratio` | clock | number | `0.62` | Share of the height given to the time row |

## Style presets

`preset` applies a bundle of the keys above before any of your own are
read, so you can start from a theme and change just the parts you want.

| Preset | Looks like |
| --- | --- |
| `midnight` | Deep navy card, soft white text |
| `glass` | Frosted translucent panel |
| `minimal` | No panel - text with a drop shadow |
| `neon` | Black panel, glowing cyan text |
| `sunset` | Purple panel, orange to pink gradient |
| `aurora` | Teal panel, mint to sky gradient |
| `terminal` | Phosphor green on black, monospaced |
| `blueprint` | Drafting blue with monospaced text |
| `carbon` | Flat near-black with a hairline border |
| `paper` | Light theme, warm off-white |
| `nord` | Nord palette |
| `mocha` | Catppuccin Mocha palette |
| `dracula` | Dracula palette |
| `gruvbox` | Gruvbox Dark palette |
| `solarized` | Solarized Dark palette |

## Time and date patterns

`time_format` and `date_format` take .NET-style tokens. Everything that is
not a token is copied through; use `\` to escape one character and
`'single quotes'` for a literal run.

| Token | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `H` / `HH` | Hour, 24-hour | `7` / `07` |
| `h` / `hh` | Hour, 12-hour | `7` / `07` |
| `m` / `mm` | Minute | `5` / `05` |
| `s` / `ss` | Second | `9` / `09` |
| `f` | Tenths of a second | `4` |
| `t` / `tt` | AM/PM designator | `P` / `PM` |
| `d` / `dd` | Day of month | `3` / `03` |
| `ddd` / `dddd` | Weekday name | `Tue` / `Tuesday` |
| `M` / `MM` | Month number | `9` / `09` |
| `MMM` / `MMMM` | Month name | `Sep` / `September` |
| `yy` / `yyyy` | Year | `26` / `2026` |

Weekday, month and AM/PM names come from the current Windows locale.

```ini
time_format=h:mm tt
date_format=dddd, d MMMM
date_format=ddd d MMM 'in' yyyy
```

## Anchors

`x` and `y` are an offset from the `anchor` point on the target monitor,
not absolute desktop coordinates. A widget anchored `top_right` with
`x=-60` sits 60px in from the right edge and stays there when the screen
resolution changes.

`monitor` selects a display by index; `-1` means the primary one.
